description: Source code for the WPEFramework plugin's Probe functionality, including discovery, request handling, response creation, and broadcasting mechanisms.

classes.name: Discovery
classes.description: Helper class for constructing discovery response data with various constructors for different discovery scenarios.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Handles incoming discovery requests, manages responses, and maintains state for discovery process.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting responses and processing incoming broadcast data.

methods.name: Probe::WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Transforms incoming Web::Request data, specifically looking for M-SEARCH keywords in UDP messages.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to partial Web requests.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Received
methods.description: Processes incoming discovery requests, validates them, and responds if valid.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Send
methods.description: Handles sending responses and manages the list of destinations.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::ValidRequest
methods.description: Validates incoming discovery requests, including signature validation if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a discovery response message with latency and optional model info, including optional signature.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming broadcast data, validates responses, and reports discovered devices.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ValidResponse
methods.description: Validates broadcast responses, including signature validation if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Records discovered devices with their URL, latency, model, and security status.
